ITEM.PTXT: Ne/G2Based on the signal, air flow meter signal, accelerator opening signal, coolant temperature signal, etc., the engine control computer calculates the optimum ignition timing for the driving conditions and sends an ignition signal to the ignition coil with igniter.

HINT.PTXT: Ignition timing = A. Initial set ignition timing or B. Basic advance angle + C. Corrective advance angle

ENTRY.PTXT: When the engine is started, the timing is fixed at BTDC5°. In addition, when the service terminals are shorted and the throttle is off, the timing is fixed at BTDC10°.
The optimum ignition timing is selected from a map based on the signals from each sensor.
Based on the signals from each sensor, appropriate advance and retard corrections are made according to the engine condition at that time.
When the coolant temperature is low, the ignition timing is advanced according to the driving conditions to improve driveability.
When the idle speed decreases, the ignition timing is advanced, and when it increases, the timing is retarded, to stabilize the idle speed.
C-3 Retard at Fuel Cut Recovery
At fuel cut recovery, the ignition timing is retarded to reduce shock.
Driveability is improved by temporarily retarding the ignition timing during acceleration.
When knocking occurs, the ignition timing is corrected based on the signal from the knock sensor.
